selection_rule: Lowest validation expected cost among all observed threshold partitions. Staff time is costed and reported; no fixed daily workload limit.
selection_note: Student removes the fixed 92-minute capacity limit and selects minimum expected validation cost, including staff time valued at EUR20/hour. Workload is reported as time released for other duties. Retain the confirmed YOLO11s 20-epoch weights. The hybrid optimum is unchanged; the model-alone cutoff is reselected on validation without the cap, before applying it to the previously seen test predictions.
